017package org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.pages;
018
019import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.freemarker.console.*;
020import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.views.*;
021import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.views.RowAction.*;
022import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.views.TableSpec.*;
023
024/**
025 * Builder twin of the Users page (P11, {@code users.ftlh}).
026 *
027 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
028 * <p class='bjava'>
029 *    <jk>return</jk> <jsm>twin</jsm>(<jv>req</jv>, UsersPageBuilders.<jsm>users</jsm>());
030 * </p>
031 */
032@SuppressWarnings({
033   "java:S1192" // Page-definition ids and labels repeat as inline literals by design.
034})
035public final class UsersPageBuilders {
036
037   private UsersPageBuilders() {}
038
039   /**
040    * P11 Users.
041    *
042    * @return The page spec.
043    */
044   public static PageSpec users() {
045      return PageSpec.create().tab("users").toolkit("views")
046         .table(TableSpec.create("users").rowType("User").dataMode(DataMode.SERVER).dataUrl("/console/users/query")
047            .defaultOrder("username", Sort.ASC)
048            .columns(
049               Column.create("username").label("Username"),
050               Column.create("firstName").label("First name"),
051               Column.create("lastName").label("Last name"),
052               Column.create("userStatus").label("Status").render("pill"))
053            .ribbon(
054               RibbonItem.optionGroup("userStatus",
055                  RibbonItem.option("active").title("Active").column("userStatus").value("$eq(ACTIVE)"),
056                  RibbonItem.option("inactive").title("Inactive").column("userStatus").value("$eq(INACTIVE)"))
057                  .title("User status").deselectable(true),
058               RibbonItem.dialog("add-user").title("+ Add user").symbol("plus")
059                  .form("/console/users/form").endpoint("/console/users").method(Method.POST).onSuccess(OnSuccess.REDRAW),
060               RibbonItem.refresh())
061            .rowActions(
062               RowAction.create("edit").label("Edit").form("/console/users/form?username={username}").present(Present.DIALOG)
063                  .endpoint("/console/users/{username}").method(Method.PUT).onSuccess(OnSuccess.REDRAW),
064               RowAction.create("delete").label("Delete").endpoint("/console/users/{username}").method(Method.DELETE)
065                  .confirm("Delete user '{username}'?").confirmLabel("Delete").tone(Tone.DANGER).onSuccess(OnSuccess.REDRAW)),
066            "Users");
067   }
068}
